title: AYE SHASHMAAHE PYAASE ASGHAR
body:
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Qalbe Pidar Jaane Maadar
Aye tashna daha'n Aye tashna jigar
Baba ki Mashiyat par thi Nazar
Jab teer laga tha Gardan par
Rann Jeet liya Tu ne Has kar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Faatehe Khaibar ke Dilbar
Ek zarbe tabassum ke bal par
Aada ka ulat'ta Tu lashkar
Shabbir ki Marzi hoti agar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Ibne Ali ka hai Beta
Abbase Ali hai Tera Chacha
Hai Tujhme Shuja'at ka Dariya
Aur Shere Khuda ke Hain Tewar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir ke Maqsad ke Qur'an
Gehwaare me Bachcha kehla jaha'n
Aidaan me lekin Tu hai Jawaa'n
Kab khaof hai Tere Chehre par
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Auro'n se Juda hai Shaan Teri
Ek teer ne leli Jaan Teri
Talwar bani Muskaan Teri
Yu'n fatt'ha Kiya Toone lashkar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Uss teer ka khana khel nahi'n
Aur phir Muskana khel nahi'n
Dushman ko rulana khel nahi'n
Hai Teri Shuja'at Tera Jigar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir ke Dilbar Maahjabee'n
Abbas ka Tu Shaagird nahi'n
Hai Jeet ka phir bhi Tujhko yagee'n
Tha Zarbe Tabassum ka jo hunar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye rasm nahi'n hai Maatam hai
Waajib hai jo ham par wo Gham hai
Ham jaan bhi dede'n to kam hai
Ehsaan kiya Tune ham par
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Hasta hai Masoom koi
Besaakhta yaad aati hai Teri
Raas aayi na Tujhko Teri Hasi
Ye lag gayi aakhir Kiski nazar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye zulm kahi'n dekha na suna
Sookhi wo Zubaa'n aur Khushk Gala
Ek boond Tujhe paani na mila
Tu Qatl Huwa Pyaasa Rehkar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab teer Teri Gardan pa Laga
Aadam ne kaleja Thaam liya
Ayyub ne Apna Muh Phera
Ulta jo Pidar ke Haatho'n par
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Baap na aise ham dekhe
Hai kaun jo aisa Gham dekhe
Besheer ka ye Aalam dekhe
Ye Sheh ka hai Dil Bano ka Jigar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Saamaane Aza me hai Jhoola
Jhoole me Alam ek Chhota sa
Aur uspe bandha hai ek Sehra
<<MINI>>
Kya khoon rulata hai manzar
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Gehwaare se wo gir jaana Tera
Maidaan me Sajkar Aana Tera
Wo Joshe Wegha Dikhlana Tera
<<MINI>>
Kya khoon rulata hai manzar
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo teen dino ki Pyaas Teri
Wo dhoopki shiddat wo garmi
Wo teer ka lagna aur wo hasi
Hairaan hain ab tak jinnobashar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Faatehe Dashte Karbobala
Tiflee'n me ye Tera Joshe Wegha
Tu Hota Jawaa'n to kya hota
Ham sonchte hain ye reh rehkar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ehsas ki duniya Rothi hai
Ek Maadar e Dukhiya Rothi hai
Haa'n Fatima Zehra Rothi Hai
Kehti Hai faqat ye Ro Rokar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Mango ye DuaMaatam daaro
Ta hashr Kisi dukhiya Maa ko
Aulaad ka Gham is tarha na ho
Bano ne jo Dekhe hain manzar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Halq pa teere zulm laga
Us Halg pa Khanjar bhi to chala
Tharraane Laga Tha Arshe Khuda
Naize pa Tera wo Phool Sa Sar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya kya na huwe the ranjo mehan
Gardan me Sakina ke thi rasan
Ro Ro ke magar Wo Teri Bahan
Kehti Thi Faqat Asghar Asghar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aankho'n me Tere Laashe ko liye
Maa Teri Jiye to kaise Jiye
Paani Wo Piye to kaise Piye
Hardamm hai ye Naoha Honto'n par
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Ghurbate Sarwar Waawaila
Godi me Liye Tera Laasha
Shabbir ne hamko Yaad Kiya
Ham sadqe Aisi Ghurbat par
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir ke jo parwaane hain
Wo Teri Azmath jaane hain
Aur Haq ko Tere pehchaane hain
Gham Tera manaate hain ghar ghar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaliq Ne jo Bakhsha Tera Gham
Ye Uska bada hai hampa Karam
Ab Tujh se ye wada karte hain ham
Mar jaaengeTujh par ro ro kar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Shehre atash ke Shahzade
Tu Apni Ziyarat Karwaade
Karbal me hame ab pohncha de
Rolenge Wahaa'n ham jee bhar kar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho'n Tujh pa Mere Maa Baap fida
Shahzade ye Ahsan ki hai Dua
Madfan ho Mera bas Karbo bala
Waa'n Naoha Sunaau'n roro kar
<<MINI>>
Aye Shashmaahe Pyaase Asghar
author: Hasan Abbas Ahsan
